title: The empty-container collapse, followed all the way to the reconstructed JSON document
rationale: The known DEFECT is pinned as an equality between two flattened maps - a statement about the middle of the pipeline. What a user experiences is the end. A non-empty sibling is present so the fixture also proves the collapse is local and does not damage neighbouring structure.
catchesBugClass: Regression in either direction on the empty-container contract, and specifically a partial fix that repairs {} but not []. The nonEmpty sibling catches a fix that over-reaches and starts emitting spurious nulls beside real data.
cannotCatch: Cannot distinguish the three collapsed cases from each other after the fact. It also does not cover empty containers nested inside arrays, which take an entirely different code path.

predicted.detail: Three different authored values arrive as the same null; nonEmpty is untouched.
